**Build the mobile app that construction professionals rely on every day.

**Every day, tens of thousands of construction professionals around the world use the Dalux app to inspect buildings, document progress, navigate BIM models, capture photos, report issues and collaborate directly from active construction sites.

We're looking for Mobile Software Engineers who want to build software that solves real-world problems at scale.

**What You'll Be Building

**You'll join one of our cross-functional product teams responsible for developing and improving the Dalux mobile application.

Together with developers, product managers and designers, you'll help shape new features from the product discussion through implementation, testing and release.

Our app is built using C# and .NET MAUI , allowing us to share the majority of our codebase while integrating with native iOS and Android capabilities whenever it makes sense.

**Some of the challenges you'll work on

**Mobile development at Dalux goes far beyond forms and lists. You'll help solve challenges such as:

• Building reliable workflows for construction sites with limited connectivity

• Integrating with mobile hardware such as 360 cameras and GPS antennas

• Optimizing performance across both Android and iOS devices

• Designing intuitive user experiences for professionals working in demanding environments

• Continuously improving the speed, quality and usability of one of the industry's leading mobile applications

**Our engineering culture

**You'll become part of a product team where engineers have real ownership.

We believe the people building the software should influence how it's built. That means short decision paths, close collaboration with product and design, and plenty of room to propose new ideas.

Our development teams work using agile principles with a strong focus on quality, collaboration and continuous improvement.

**We'd love to hear from you if you

**

• Have a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a similar technical field

• Enjoy solving complex engineering problems

• Care about building products that people genuinely enjoy using

• Like collaborating with other developers, designers and product managers

Experience with one or more of the following is a plus:

• C#

• .NET MAUI

• Kotlin

• Swift

• Flutter

• React Native

If you don't have professional mobile experience yet but are passionate about mobile development and have a strong software engineering foundation, we'd still encourage you to apply.

**Why Dalux?

**At Dalux, you'll build software that makes one of the world's largest industries more digital, efficient and sustainable.

Our products are used in more than 140 countries, and mobile is central to that experience.

All software development happens from our headquarters in Copenhagen, where you'll work alongside a growing community of software engineers in an environment that values knowledge sharing, technical discussions and continuous learning. We also have monthly social events and various clubs for those who want to take part.

You'll find a flat organization with a high degree of trust, opportunities to influence the product, and colleagues who care deeply about building great software.

**Ready to join us?

**If you'd like to help build the mobile platform used by tens of thousands of construction professionals every day, we'd love to hear from you.

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

**About Dalux

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005. We develop digital tools that help make the construction industry smarter and more efficient through intuitive software and Building Information Modelling (BIM). Today, our solutions are used on construction projects in more than 140 countries worldwide.

**About The Company

**Founded in 2019, Novutech is a dynamic digital transformation partner with a team of over 60 consultants across Europe. We specialize in finance-focused digital transformation projects for international scale-ups and mid-sized enterprises. Our expertise lies in leveraging a core tech stack and the experience from hundreds of successful projects. We are committed to designing, delivering, and supporting end-to-end solutions that drive growth and efficiency.

Leveraging your NetSuite expertise, you will lead complex implementations, oversee advanced configurations, and act as a trusted advisor. You will also mentor junior consultants and progressively develop your people management skills, with the opportunity to lead your own team in the future.

• Lead and execute end-to-end NetSuite implementation projects, from requirements gathering to go-live and post-implementation support.

• Oversee advanced NetSuite configurations and customizations to meet customer needs, acting as a Subject Matter Expert.

• Configure, customize, and optimize NetSuite modules according to client needs.

• Monitor, test, validate, and resolve advanced problems in NetSuite areas.

• Maintain and document high-level processes and complex customizations for external stakeholders.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing best practices and recommendations.

• Experience a place where you can grow, learn, and make a significant impact.

• Benefit from a good work-life balance, fostering both personal and professional well-being.

• Strong understanding of business processes (Finance, Accounting, Operations, etc.).

• Experience working in a consulting environment or with multiple clients.

• Demonstrated experience in mentoring, coaching, or supervising junior team members.

• Customer Success Management experience is a plus.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to build strong client relationships.

• Analytical and problem-solving mindset, with attention to detail.

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative, international team.

• Entrepreneurial spirit and drive for continuous improvement.

• Fluent in English; knowledge of French or Dutch is a plus.

• Willingness to travel occasionally within Europe as required.

If you are excited about the opportunity to make a difference and grow with us, we want to hear from you! Join Novutech and be part of an adventure that’s shaping the future of digital transformation.

**About GoWish, Ønskeskyen ☁️

**At GoWish, we’re building the world’s leading wish-list and social shopping platform - a place where you can make a real impact and have fun doing it.

We’re on a mission to reinvent gifting for millions. We win together, driven by curiosity, ownership, and bold ideas that turn into real products. We experiment cross-functionally, push for excellence, and keep things playful as we grow - together.

**Team & Role Overview

**We're actually opening two positions on the team, at two different levels of seniority.

• One for an engineer with 2-4 years of experience and meaningful, production-scale work behind them.

• One for a more experienced engineer, with 4-6 years across one or two companies and a strong track record at production scale.

Not sure which one is you? Apply anyway — tell us where you're at, and we'll place you at the right level together.

The Product API team is the team behind the systems that turn billions of products into the fast, reliable data our users experience every day. You'll design and build high-performance backend services, push our web scraping and data pipelines to new scale, and help shape the architecture that keeps everything running smoothly as we grow. If you thrive on distributed systems, high-throughput data, and clean, performant code — and you like being the person others turn to in an architectural discussion — we would like to hear from you.

**Responsibilities

**

• Develop scalable, high-performance backend services using Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript

• Build and optimize advanced web scraping systems capable of handling billions of products daily

• Implement real-time data pipelines and stream processing solutions using Kafka

• Leverage in-memory caching with Redis to ensure extremely fast data retrieval and updates

• Work closely with our distributed NoSQL databases to handle large-scale data effectively

• Collaborate in a cross-functional team — taking an active part in architectural discussions, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions

**What we’re looking for 🌟

****We Imagine That You Have

**

• Strong expertise in Node.js and dependency injection frameworks such as NestJS

• Solid understanding and hands-on experience with PubSub/Kafka or other stream processing tools

• Proficiency in managing and optimizing NoSQL or SQL databases, with practical experience using Redis or other in-memory databases for caching

• Familiarity with cloud-native technologies, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and microservices architecture

• Experience managing distributed systems and microservices at scale

**It is further seen as an advantage to have experience with:

**

• Designing and implementing efficient web scraping systems

• MongoDB in production global / sharded use-cases

• Multi-cluster / multi-regional deployments and databases, or Vector Search use-cases

• AI applications at work — e.g. reviewer agents or similar

• High-performance applications dealing with high I/O scenarios

Why GoWish should sit at top of your career wish list 💙

At GoWish, we believe great work comes from people who feel energized, supported, and excited to show up every day. That’s why we’ve built a workplace where celebration, growth, and genuine enjoyment are part of the journey - not perks on the side.

Take your birthday off with Happy Birthday Leave, enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully recharge, and join a team that fills the year with events and playful happenings. We invest in your future with pension and insurance, fuel your days with a weekly lunch scheme, and keep you going with unlimited snacks and sodas - because work should feel good.

At GoWish, you don’t just build great products. You build a great work life.

**Practical information

**We collaborate in a flexible setup, with most of our magic happening at our bright, modern office in Østerbro - perfectly placed between Nordhavn and Østerport Station. We’re ready for you to join us as soon as you are.

👉 Ready to help shape a platform that already empowers 18+ million users (and counting)? Join us at GoWish - and let’s build the future of data-driven innovation together.

Don’t wait to apply - we review applications continuously and may close the position once the right candidate is found.

**Shape the Future of Privacy

**

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

**About the Office of AI

**

The Office of AI owns the strategy, governance, infrastructure, and enablement of AI across Usercentrics. We sit within the CTO office and work across all departments.

**Mission: enable the entire organisation to adopt AI safely, responsibly, and effectively.

**

**About the role

**

You are the senior technical owner of AI enablement at Usercentrics: the person who takes the hardest department AI builds, the deepest platform problems, and the technical bar the rest of the enablement track works to.

The role has two layers, and we mean both. At the department layer, you do what every AI Enablement Engineer does, prototyping and shipping AI applications for Finance, Legal, HR, Marketing, Customer Success, BI and beyond, but you take the hardest ones yourself and set the pattern the others follow. At the platform layer, you own the infrastructure that makes all of that possible: the LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, evaluation frameworks, and the engineering standards product teams build against.

What you would be walking into: a real internal AI platform already adopted across the company, the AI Hub, MCP servers, Claude connector delivery, a skill hub, usage analytics, and low-code automation. The next layer is largely open. A gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks are the current candidates, and you would have a strong say in what gets built and in what order. Real adoption already exists, which is a rarer starting point than a blank slate.

The role asks for two things at once. You are a deeply technical engineer who can architect and build these systems hands-on, at the hardest end of the department builds and the platform layer both. And you build a technical community: you raise the bar across the Enablement Engineers and beyond through education, mentoring, and reusable patterns. If you only have one of these, this is probably not your role.

You will work alongside the AI Enablement Lead, who owns the non-technical adoption pillar (the champion network, AI literacy, and the cross-department use-case pipeline). Your focus is the engineering depth behind that pipeline, from the department app someone is using tomorrow to the platform layer that will still be standing in two years.

On the shape of it: this is a small, senior team today, four to five people, and growing on both the engineering and enablement sides. You would be the most senior engineer on the enablement track and the technical bar would be yours to set.

**Requirements

****What you will do

**

• Take on the hardest department AI application builds yourself, and set the technical pattern the AI Enablement Engineers work to

• Own the platform layer that supports every department build: LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks are the current candidates, and you help decide what they are

• Own the internal AI marketplace: keep the cross-departmental AI apps secure, maintained, and governed as the number of them grows

• Own evaluation frameworks and the guardrails that let the team move fast without shipping unreliable AI: output quality, hallucination detection, regression testing

• Set the engineering standards and integration patterns for AI that product and department teams build against

• Raise the engineering bar across the org. Run technical education and enablement for engineers, document reusable patterns, and mentor builders beyond your own team

• Partner with the AI Enablement Lead, Security, and Platform Engineering to ship AI capabilities that are safe, governed, and adopted

• Translate company-wide AI goals into concrete engineering roadmaps and measurable outcomes

**What you bring

**

• 8+ years in software engineering, with significant time at staff level owning complex systems end to end

• Staff-level technical depth. You can own the most complex problems on the enablement track, from a department build to platform infrastructure, and lead by being the strongest engineer in the room

• Genuinely hands-on with AI. You have built and shipped production systems with LLMs, AI agents, RAG, or applied ML yourself, at both application and infrastructure layers

• A strong engineering foundation in distributed systems, backend platform design, and cloud architecture (Azure or GCP), with the judgement to set standards others follow

• A track record of mentoring senior engineers and unblocking ambiguous architecture without heavy process overhead

• A real technical-community or education background. You have taught, mentored at scale, run developer communities, written the docs, or evangelised technology to engineers beyond your own team

• Clear, direct communication, strong in async and written form. You align stakeholders across security, platform, and product without slowing the team down

**Nice to have

**

• Experience with multi-cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP) and modern DevOps practices

• Background in AI governance, evaluation, or responsible AI deployment

• Experience operating in a regulated or privacy-focused domain

• Recognition as a developer advocate, community leader, conference speaker, or similar (e.g. Google Developer Expert)

• Former founder or CTO experience, comfortable owning ambiguity end to end

**Benefits

****Why join Usercentrics?

**

• Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

• Company culture is important to us. We strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

• Get involved. We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all departments enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

• Your work-life balance is important to us too. We offer flexible working hours, hybrid working, and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

• We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon and Prague, Buenos Aires and New York.

Some of our benefits

• 
Development budget for every employee: €800 per year

• 
Job-related language courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish, etc.): €350 per year

• 
Hybrid working policy with the option to take a workcation (up to 60 days per year)

• 
Online yoga sessions

• 
Events: team buildings, happy hours, parties/get-togethers, and occasional company-covered breakfasts or lunches (in-office, across offices, online, and in person)

• 
Gifts: we celebrate life and work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new baby arrivals, and similar occasions)

• 
Snacks, fruit, coffee, and drinks in the office

ABOUT US

We are driven by our values #BeBrave, #BetterTogether, #LeadbyExample, #InnovateWithPurpose, #PassionForPrivacy, #GiveBack and #ComeAsYouAre. They show what we believe in and how we work. They help make our team special and guide us in everything we do. They're the heart of our company and inspire us to do our best every day.

We believe that our different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are our greatest strengths — so we are committed to building with them as we foster innovation and drive our success.

We recognize that this is an ongoing journey. We commit to listening and to continuous learning, growth, and improvement. By embracing DEI principles, we will create a more just and equitable society, and we are proud to play our part in making this vision a reality.

We are #BetterTogether.

About ChemoMetec

ChemoMetec is a worldwide leading manufacturer of cell counting and analysis equipment. We specialize in developing and producing high-precision instrumentation, delivering consistent data for thousands of customers across biotech, pharma, and academic segments.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and scientifically skilled Product Specialist - Technical Support & Documentation to lead technical support for ChemoMetec’s portfolio of analytical cell-counting instruments. In this support-centered role, you will handle technical inquiries from both customers and colleagues and act as the go-to reference for technically accurate and compliant solutions. The role combines life science, technical documentation, and QA collaboration, making it ideal for someone with a strong scientific background and a passion for structured problem-solving.

We are hiring two Product Specialists for our technical support team: one focused on documentation and one on data analysis. You will be part of the Product Management Department and work closely with QA, Field Application Scientists, and product teams to resolve customer complaints, complete technical documentation, and maintain our support infrastructure. A solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, along with a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements, is essential to succeed in this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide technical support across all instrument platforms, with a focus on structured problem-solving and documentation.

• Collaborate with QA to complete technical questionnaires and support the resolution of customer complaints.

• Maintain and organize our support database platform, ensuring technical records are accurate and accessible.

• Proofread and write technical notes, user guides, and comparison studies.

• Develop and implement procedures to support both existing and new products.

• Ensure all support activities comply with GMP and relevant quality standards.

• Act as a subject matter expert on instrumentation and scientific applications, providing technical insight to internal teams.

Your Profile

• PhD in Biology, Physics, or a related scientific discipline.

• Solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, and a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements.

• Strong understanding of microscopy, analytical instrumentation, and pharmaceutical workflows.

• Highly organized, structured, and detail-oriented.

• Excellent written communication skills, with experience producing technical documentation.

• Familiarity with support platforms or ticketing systems is a plus.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, technical environment.

Why join ChemoMetec?

At ChemoMetec, we believe that great people make a great workplace. We value both personal and professional development and offer an environment where you can grow, take responsibility, and make an impact. You will become part of a team of talented and supportive colleagues who enjoy working together in an informal and welcoming atmosphere. We also believe that strong relationships go beyond the workplace, which is why we regularly bring colleagues together through company-wide events to build connections and strengthen relationships across the organization.

Practical information

Both positions are on-site at our HQ in Allerød, Denmark. You will refer to Director, Ph.D. Product Management Bassam Tawfik.

Starting date is as soon as possible, and we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. Deadline for applying is 20 November 2026.

If you have any further questions about this job opportunity, feel free to contact Frederikke Hvidberg, fhv@chemometec.com

**Build full-stack AI agents for science, with freedom, room to be creative, and real ownership, in a lively startup in Copenhagen.

**An AI agent is only as useful to a scientist as the data it can see and trust. Dalea gives research labs structured data with full provenance, and we want AI co-scientists that do real scientific work on top of it. You'll own the AI side of that.

What you'll own

• The agent harness and the framework for AI co-scientist agents, from architecture to the workflows they run.

• Our MCP integrations, which give agents access to lab data with a traceable record of what they do.

• Model choices: following the field, testing new models against what labs actually need, and adopting what works.

• How we evaluate AI quality.

• The infrastructure the AI runs on: inference, model serving and agent execution.

• Full-stack work wherever the AI needs deeper integration with the platform, and help elsewhere when the team needs it.

What you bring

**Must-haves

**

• You've designed and built an LLM agent system used in production, and made the architecture decisions yourself.

• Strong full-stack TypeScript (React, Next.js or close equivalents), and you're comfortable in Python.

• You've owned the direction of a technical area, including a significant rework.

• You've shipped quickly in a small team or an early-stage product.

**Nice To Have (none Of Them Required)

**

• MCP servers or clients, agent frameworks or harness tooling (open source counts)

• Tools for scientists, or a background in bioinformatics, computational biology or AI for science

• Mastra or another TypeScript agent framework

• Open-weight models, through inference APIs or self-hosting

• Kubernetes

• Systems where provenance or audit trails matter

You don't need lab or biology knowledge, a PhD or Danish. Hands-on, shipped work counts more than research or publications. If you match the must-haves, apply, even if you have none of the nice-to-haves.

Our stack

TypeScript, Next.js and React. Python for our MCP service. An agent harness built on Mastra. Docker Compose and Kubernetes, hosted on Scaleway.

How we work

Our dev team is the two founders plus up to three new developers, led by our CTO. We discuss progress and priorities closely and continuously, and we expect you to take part: share ideas early, argue for what you think is right, and change course when the evidence says so.

You won't need permission to fix what's broken, and what you build reaches production quickly. We work together at BioInnovation Institute 3–5 days a week. We're building the team and the way we work, and that happens best in person.

**About Dalea

**Dalea is a data management platform for biology and lab workflows. Experiments, structured data, samples and inventory sit in one place, with full data provenance. Everything a lab builds in Dalea can be packaged and shared, so we're building a GitHub for life science: labs publish and reuse each other's workflows instead of rebuilding them from scratch. We work with biotech startups, academic labs, pharma R&D and CROs.

Timing and our funding round

This position depends on our current funding round closing, which we expect in February/March 2027. We can make a conditional offer before then, and we'll be open with you about the timing throughout the process.

What we offer

• Salary: DKK 725,000–900,000 per year, depending on experience

• Warrants: under the Danish

• 7P scheme

• Pension: through ASE

• Location: BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen, on-site 3–5 days a week. You'll need to live in the Copenhagen area or be willing to move here. We're happy to hear from people relocating within the EU.

• Language: English

• Start: when the round closes

How to apply

jobs.description:
The Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University, Denmark, welcomes applications for a postdoctoral researcher position in developing a Tier 3 model-based national inventory of N₂O emissions modelling from cultivation of soils. The position is part of the SmartField project, which is a cross-organizational research project aimed at obtaining knowledge about N₂O emissions from agricultural fields and solutions for mitigation strategies. Additionally, SmartField will develop and deliver an improved methodology for accounting N₂O emissions at farm and national scale.

Expected start date and duration of employment

The position is to be filled by February 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter and is a two-year fixed-term position.

Job description

You will be part of a research environment addressing greenhouse gas emissions and sustainability transition of agricultural systems, with a particular focus on nitrous oxide emissions from agricultural soil aiming to scale emission estimates from the field to the national scale. Your role will primarily involve supporting the development and implementation of a model-based approach for the national of N₂O emissions from diverse agricultural soils, as well as developing the data pipeline. This will include creating and updating spatio-temporal datasets on soils, cropping systems, and field management, and calculating and assessing and comparing the resulting inventories to other approaches. Scenarios will be used to explore how mitigation technologies and management measures could reduce N₂O emissions and to assess the suitability of the proposed Tier 3 modelling framework for Denmark's national N₂O emission inventory. Your work will support a Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) system, enabling transparent, robust and science-based reporting of mitigation progress regarding agricultural field N₂O emission. You will work in close collaboration with colleagues developing and testing process-oriented models, as well as with those responsible for the national greenhouse gas inventory.

Your profile

We are searching for a highly motivated candidate who has:

• A PhD in agronomy, soil science, data science, environmental sciences, engineering, agroecology, biology, or a related field.

• Experience working with models, managing and analyzing large datasets.

• Experience working with models related to nitrogen/carbon turnover in soil is considered an advantage but is not required.

• Documented experience in scientific writing and publishing in peer-reviewed scientific journals.

• The ability to communicate effectively in English (both written and oral).

• Good collaboration skills and ability to take responsibility to work independently and proactively on the project

Who we are

The position is shared between the Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology under the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University, and it will be hosted by the Land-CRAFT Center at the AU campus in Aarhus.

The Department of Environmental Science is an interdisciplinary department with expertise ranging from physics, chemistry, microbiology, engineering, social science, geography, economics, to policy analysis. Basic as well as applied research are conducted on some of the major challenges facing society, such as pollution and pollution control mechanisms, management of land, soil, water, air and biodiversity, protection of ecosystem services, and climate change. Advisory services within these areas are offered to governmental organizations, non-governmental organizations and companies. The department consists of five sections and currently about 160 staff (including postdocs and Ph.D. students).

The Department of Agroecology contributes to sustainable solutions to some of the world’s biggest problems within the areas of soil, plants, animals, humans, and the environment. We want to make a difference by contributing to both fundamental knowledge generation and the attainment of sustainable production systems via innovative research, contracted policy advice, and education. We offer professional laboratories, greenhouses, semi-field, and field-scale research facilities, advanced computing capacities as well as an extensive national and international researcher network.  The department consists of nine research sections with around 400 highly skilled employees.

This position is hosted by Land-CRAFT - the Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Future, which aims to bring transformational solutions to agricultural systems. Land-CRAFT is a section within the Department of Agroecology. Therefore, there is a strong focus on climate change mitigation and adaptation strategies.

Both departments believe in equality, diversity, inclusion, and creating an attractive work/life balance.

What we offer

• A collaborative, international research environment that combines high academic standards with an informal and supportive atmosphere. We value accountability, curiosity, flexibility, and teamwork in everything we do.

• An inclusive and respectful workplace culture, where mutual trust, kindness, and professional dialogue are part of daily life. We encourage open communication and develop a cohesive sense of community across teams and disciplines.

• A flexible working environment that supports work-life balance and individual needs.

• An active institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion – in recruitment, career development, and everyday interactions.

• An innovative and meaningful workplace where your work contributes to solving real-world challenges. No two days are alike, and we welcome creative thinking and new ideas.

• Support for international researchers and their families, including Relocation Service and an Expat Partner Programme.

Place of work and area of employment

The place of work is Aarhus University (LandCRAFT Center), Ole Worms Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C. The affiliation will be with the Department of Environmental Science. However, it should also be expected that there will be work-related and meeting activities at the Department of Environmental Science which is located at Risø in Roskilde.

Contact information

Further information may be obtained by contacting Head of Section Emissions and Atmospheric Modelling, Professor Peter L. Langen (plangen@envs.au.dk +4520618369), Professor Jørgen E. Olesen (jeo@agro.au.dk +4540821659), or Special consultant related to the national emission inventory Mette Hjorth Mikkelsen (mhm@envs.au.dk +4587158579).

Deadline

All applications must be received no later than November 27, 2026.

Application procedure

Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.

Formalities and salary range

Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.
